scope: Line-level split for rich paragraphs (image/textbox runs) and run-level NEXT inside one block

lineSplit.implementation: Every rendered run carries data-run-index; findRunSplitAt returns {runIndex, offset} using element rects for atomic runs (image/textbox) and per-character Range rects inside text runs; splitRunsAt rebuilds before/after run arrays preserving order

richParagraph.sample: crossing-rich.docx (inline textbox run inside the crossing paragraph)

lineSplit.flowSlot: Split target derives from natural flow slot (paragraph flow top + y offset), so block-float insertion no longer hides the crossing

mailMergeNext.implementation: finishMerge uses a MergeCursor per block for both the XML field results and the merged run model; a NEXT run/field advances the cursor immediately, so later runs in the same paragraph use the next record; parser now reads NEXT fldSimple and complex NEXT fields into mergeRule
